incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 — automatic page fired for service=redwood-inference-api route=/v1/generate — observed 5xx spike from canary pool (canary-release: rtx-model-qa-v2). Paging oncall.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-74219 created. Notifying: Maya Patel (primary), Liam O'Connor (secondary). Escalation policy: 5m -> 15m.

Maya Patel: ack — I'm up. seeing the PD, pulling logs now.

Liam O'Connor: oncall here, switching to incident channel. quick summary?

Maya Patel: Canary finisher reports ~18% 500s on /v1/generate across the canary fleet over last 2m. Error is `InferenceRuntimeError: kernel mismatch during matmul` in the runtime. Not a pure OOM.

Rajesh Gupta: tagging in. I'm seeing repeated stack traces from a subset of GPUs:
```
E 03:21:12 runtime.cpp:482] matmul_kernel select failed: unsupported params for cuBLASLt 2.10.1 -> got segfault 0x7ffdb2
E 03:21:12 kv_cache.cpp:218] KV store corrupted for session=abc123
```
Looks like a CUDA/cuBLAS ABI mismatch after the runtime build changed. Could be a libcudnn/cublas minor version shift that only surfaces with longer contexts.

Sophia Chen: are errors limited to the canary region? I see canary nodes in us-west-2 only. Any customer-facing errors reported?

Maya Patel: preliminary customer impact: ~2% of requests in production hitting canary and returning 5xx; routed customers include a few sandbox orgs and one small prod tenant — support pinged Nora.

Nora Alvarez: confirmed. Support saw increased errors from tenant "acme-ai" in the last 10m. They report failed chat completions. I'll reach out to their SE while devs triage.

Liam O'Connor: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause/scale down canary, 2) rollback canary model to stable build, 3) patch runtime and re-roll. Fastest likely rollback to last known-good. Thoughts?

Rajesh Gupta: rollback of the canary model binary (not infra) should be fastest. The kernel mismatch appears to be introduced by the runtime variant compiled against a newer cuBLAS. Rolling back to the previous runtime flavor used by stable will stop the errors.

Maya Patel: agree — we should rollback canary to stable-20260310 runtime/hash. I'll prepare the rollback command.

Liam O'Connor: go ahead with rollback, assign action. I'll monitor health and keep PD open until errors drop.

Maya Patel: running rollback now. Command:
```bash
deployctl rollout rollback --service=inference-canary --to=stable-20260310 --reason "canary kernel mismatch 5xx"
```
Initiating...

pagerduty-bot: Note: Redeployment will trigger canary scale events and a brief increased latency window.

Maya Patel: rollback initiated, watching logs and metrics.

Rajesh Gupta: also starting a quick job to validate GPU driver + cuBLAS versions across canary nodes:
```bash
ssh canary-01 'nvidia-smi --query | grep CUDA' && /opt/runtime/bin/check_cublas_version.sh
```
Will report anomalies in 2m.

Nora Alvarez: updating ACME support channel and statuspage now. Status: degraded: "Partial 5xx errors for some model requests in canary — mitigation in progress". Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-74219

Sophia Chen: oncall handoff in 10m — Liam will hand to Sophia after rollback & verification.

Liam O'Connor: rollback finished on control plane side. Canary count returning to pre-release count. Initial 5xx rate dropping.

Maya Patel: logs show kernel mismatch errors ceased ~45s after rollback. Metrics: 5xx rate down to baseline within 3m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-74219: acknowledged by Maya Patel, resolved by Maya Patel. Status: resolved.

Liam O'Connor: confirming mitigation succeeded. I'll keep monitoring for 30m before closing the PD. Great job triaging.

Rajesh Gupta: I'll open a follow-up ticket to pin runtime build to specific cuBLAS/CUDA tuple and add gating tests for the runtime+driver matrix.

Nora Alvarez: customer notified: ACME SE acknowledged, will validate on their side. I'll draft a short post-incident note to customers impacted.

Maya Patel: lowering pager severity to P2 while we watch. Postmortem assigned: ENG-3894 (owner: Rajesh).

Sophia Chen: taking final watch window, handoff from Liam. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Incident closed (brief): root cause suspected runtime->GPU ABI mismatch introduced in canary build. Follow-ups: pin runtime/driver matrix, add integration tests, improve canary health thresholds to catch kernel-level regressions earlier.
